preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 99 inclusive.
The length of the input string s is divisible by 3.

preconditions.expression: all('A' <= c <= 'Z' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for i, c in enumerate(s) if c != 'SOS'[i % 3])
postconditions.description: The output is the count of characters in the received string s that differ from the expected repeating pattern 'SOS', where s is the stripped input string.
